simpleJp: ロマリア空港でチョンガラに話す
jpGuide1: チョンガラに話し掛けると、グレイシーヌへ行く
jpGuide2: チョンガラに話しかけイベント進行
enGuide: Story progression. Continue directly from “【任意】合流直後：ロマリア・グレイシーヌ準備”. This begins the first full-party country arc.

jpGuide1: イベントでサニアが仲間になる。
jpGuide2: 加入時期　グレイシーヌ編序盤
enGuide: From the Romalia-airport arrival, travel to Ramada Temple and complete the temple event until Sania joins permanently. Her recruitment is part of the mandatory Greycine story arc, so do not treat the temple as optional side content.

simpleJp: ペイサスで同じ姿の男に話す
jpGuide1: 全部で11人。11人に話したら、刑事に話し掛ける
jpGuide2: NPC11人に話しかけるイベント
enGuide: Search outside and inside both buildings until you have spoken to all 11 identical-looking men. Then go to the detective on the library's second floor and report.

jpGuide1: イベントが発生し戦闘。
enGuide: After the Peisas investigation, travel to Noyam Plains. Entering the area triggers the next mandatory battle; defeat the enemy group there, then continue to Ramada Mountain rather than returning to the world-cleanup route yet.

jpGuide1: イーガがラマダ真拳を修得する。
jpGuide2: ラマダ山　イベント進行
enGuide: From Noyam Plains, go to Ramada Mountain and climb through the required battles/events to the summit. Finishing this sequence advances the Greycine story and teaches Iga Ramada Shinken.

simpleJp: 列車砲の照準範囲から離れる
jpGuide1: 列車砲の射程範囲内に入ると、敵味方関わらず次のターンにダメージ
jpGuide2: この戦闘に勝利すればグレイシーヌ編クリア
enGuide: The train cannon targets a 3×3 area and damages anyone still there on the next turn, friend or foe. Move out of the marked zone each turn while eliminating the enemy force. Next: “【任意】グレイシーヌ後：依頼チェーン・世界巡回”.
